evals.prompt: Can you make a draw.io diagram of our web app: browser to API, API to Postgres, and API to an email service? Keep the page light.
evals.expected_output: A complete, parseable, uncompressed .drawio document with the required root cells, one vertex per component, directed edges written after the vertices, a light page background, and an export command that does not make the page transparent.
assertions: Outputs a complete uncompressed .drawio XML document (`<mxfile>`, `<diagram>`, `<mxGraphModel>`, `<root>`) that contains `<mxCell id="0"/>` and `<mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>`
Has vertex cells (`vertex="1"`) labeled browser, API, Postgres and email service
Has edge cells (`edge="1"`) whose `source`/`target` run browser to API, API to Postgres and API to the email service, and the edge cells come after the vertex cells in the file
Sets a light `background` (for example `#ffffff`) on `<mxGraphModel>` and does not export with `-t` or `DRAWIO_BACKGROUND=transparent`

evals.prompt: Use the supplied `find_aws_icon.py` results fixture to create an AWS architecture .drawio XML for Quarto: CloudFront serves a public S3 site; API Gateway invokes Lambda, which reads DynamoDB. Use official icon names, orthogonal routed arrows, Noto Sans JP, and PNG export guidance for a dark plate. Give XML and the export command; do not claim execution.
evals.expected_output: Draw.io XML using the resIcon identifiers from the fixture, the CloudFront to S3 and API Gateway to Lambda to DynamoDB flow with orthogonal edges, fontFamily on every text-bearing cell, a dark background with light text, and a proposed DRAWIO_BACKGROUND=dark export command that is not claimed as run.
assertions: Uses the fixture `resIcon` identifiers for CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, and DynamoDB.
Sets `fontFamily=Noto Sans JP` in the style of every text-bearing cell, edges included, rather than relying on `defaultFontFamily` alone.
Has orthogonal edges (`edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle`) from CloudFront to S3, API Gateway to Lambda and Lambda to DynamoDB.
Uses a dark `background` with light text and proposes `DRAWIO_BACKGROUND=dark` with `convert-drawio-to-png.sh`, without `-t`; does not claim it ran.

evals.prompt: My draw.io diagram (evals/files/broken-group.drawio) has a frame around a group, but moving the frame leaves its services behind and the connector labels are hidden. Fix the XML and tell me how to verify it.
evals.expected_output: Corrected XML where ecs and rds are children of the subnet frame with coordinates converted to frame-relative values, the edges moved after the vertices with e-https parented to the page, and a re-export plus visual PNG check.
assertions: Sets `parent="subnet"` on `ecs` and `rds` and converts their geometry to coordinates relative to the frame (`ecs` x=40 y=90, `rds` x=240 y=90)
Moves the edge cells after the vertex cells (out of the back layer) so the frame no longer covers the lines and the HTTPS and SQL labels
Keeps `e-https` on parent `1`, the common ancestor, because ALB sits outside the frame
Requires re-exporting and visually checking the PNG

evals.prompt: rename the Payments box to Billing in evals/files/compressed-flow.drawio and give me the new png. when i open the file in my editor the <diagram> part is just gibberish
evals.expected_output: Recognises a compressed diagram, decodes it with the drawio CLI before editing, renames the Payments cell in the decoded XML, then exports with the converter script and checks the PNG.
assertions: Identifies the `<diagram>` content as compressed (deflated, base64) and does not edit or hand-decode the base64 text
Decodes it with a `drawio -x -f xml -u` call (for example to a temp file that is checked for `<mxGraphModel>` and then moved over the original) before editing
Renames by changing `value="Payments"` to `value="Billing"` in the decoded XML, not by a text replace on the compressed file
Exports with `convert-drawio-to-png.sh` without `--stage` and checks the resulting PNG visually

evals.prompt: Draw the notification-pipeline refactor in notification-refactor.md as an editable draw.io diagram for our design doc (light page, Noto Sans JP). Give the XML only; do not claim it was exported.
evals.expected_output: Uncompressed .drawio XML with one container per group as the parent of its children, the store as a cylinder, orthogonal edges written after all vertices, and per-cell fontFamily.
assertions: Outputs a complete uncompressed .drawio XML document with `<mxCell id="0"/>` and `<mxCell id="1" parent="0"/>`
Contains all eleven components from the fixture as vertex cells
Makes the ingest, routing and delivery groups containers and gives each child its container as `parent`, with coordinates relative to that container, not sibling rectangles drawn behind the nodes
Keeps every child at least 30px inside its container edge (`30 <= y` and `y + height <= container height - 30`)
Draws Notification Store with a cylinder shape such as `shape=cylinder3`
Writes every edge cell after all vertex cells, with `edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle` and no arrow routed through a box it does not connect
Sets `fontFamily=Noto Sans JP` in the style of every text-bearing cell, edges included, and a light `background` on `<mxGraphModel>`
Compares the node count with the ~12-node split limit and either stages the diagram (context first, then one diagram per group) or keeps one picture with a stated reason
